items.title: Building an Agentic AI Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.excerpt: Stand up a governed, multi-account Agentic AI Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post walks through the architecture and an open-source reference blueprint: the operating model, control plane, per-Workstream cells, separate inference and tool gateways, and a CI/CD evaluation pipeline that gates each agent before production.

items.title: Distributed training with Ray Train DLCs and EFA on EKS
items.excerpt: The Ray Train Deep Learning Container ships the full CUDA-through-EFA stack, so you build no image. This post walks through a reproducible sample that fine-tunes Qwen2.5-1.5B with PyTorch FSDP across eight GPUs on two EFA-enabled g6.12xlarge instances on Amazon EKS, using the container exactly as published.

items.title: Accelerating software delivery with agentic QA automation using Amazon Nova Act – Part 3
items.excerpt: As QA test automation spreads across an organization, organizing tests and controlling who owns them becomes the real work.
